name: onepipeline-install-documented-selection
//: What decides whether a pull request's test jobs run `onepipeline:install-documented`: `scripts/ci-job.sh` keeps that target in test-linux's, test-windows' and test-macos' lists only when this project is affected (`scripts/nx-affected.sh --affects`). It runs nothing itself. The documented install builds the remote's default branch, never the pull request's code, so what a pull request can break in it is only what it reads from this tree, which `installDocumentedSelection` lists; every push to main that affects the crate runs it in `timed`.

test.//: The selection this project answers is driven by .github/ci-shape/install-proofs.test.mjs, and the proof it selects is the crate's install-documented.

input-selection.//: Selection-only edges: Nx affected reads a target's file inputs as project touches.
